Hi ramp crew,
The departures lead asked me to write about desk cover. Please keep an eye on the Companion Animal Travel Desk handoff board and make sure any new pet files are placed where the welcome team can see them right away. When a traveler arrives with paperwork, check the carrier tag, confirm the pet name, and send the file over to the cabin-side runner without delay.

For incoming cases, keep the notes clear and brief so the next person can step in without guessing. <<FACT F082>> If a rabbit file is waiting, flag it for review before you move anything else. For larger animals, use the regular crate check and make sure the dimensions in the file match what is loaded. <<FACT F069>> If you spot a loose latch, stop and let the lead know before the cart leaves the desk area.

We also need a clean handoff for cat bookings that come through late in the day. <<FACT F061>> If you are unsure whether a carrier is ready, ask the senior coordinator to verify it instead of trying to fix it on your own. Thanks for helping keep Aurelia Skyways calm and organized for the travelers and their pets.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
